version 17.9
hostname l3-c31
!
username admin privilege 15 secret 0 Example-Secret-1
!
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
!
vlan 10
 name sample-office
!
vlan 20
 name sample-voice
!
track 1 ip sla 1 reachability
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description office desk
 switchport access vlan 10
 switchport mode access
 switchport voice vlan 20
 switchport port-security maximum 3
 switchport port-security violation restrict
 switchport port-security
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface Vlan10
 description sample office
 ip address 192.0.2.2 255.255.255.128
 ip access-group 110 in
 vrrp 10 ip 192.0.2.1
 vrrp 10 priority 120
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 192.0.2.126 track 1
!
ip sla 1
 icmp-echo 192.0.2.126
 frequency 5
ip sla schedule 1 life forever start-time now
!
access-list 10 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127
access-list 110 remark sample office in
access-list 110 permit tcp 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 any eq www
access-list 110 permit icmp any any echo
!
logging host 192.0.2.20
snmp-server community example-ro RO 10
ntp server 192.0.2.10
!
banner motd ^C
sample notice: authorized use only
^C
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 30
line vty 0 4
 access-class 10 in
 exec-timeout 10 0
 login local
 transport input ssh
!
end
